verdict.rationale: cubic ships an official, documented CLI. `cubic review` checks uncommitted local changes before you push, and it generates a fix prompt for your coding agent, which fits AI-native workflows. It can also run local reviews on models from a connected ChatGPT or Claude Code subscription. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, evidence of CLI commands beyond local review (e.g., install and full command reference).
